assets.name: Rainy street with streetlamps
assets.description: Panel illustration drawn as clean line art plus flat fill and shadow layers, so every art register (halftone pop, screentone, ink noir, flat colour, newsprint) is a treatment of the same drawing; framed for a panel, with a declared balloon zone.
assets.purpose: Establishing shots: where the song is.
assets.references: Phase 1 C.12; research B.22 (Ben-Day dots and screentone); public-domain comics for lettering and panel grammar only. No existing characters, mascots, logos or recognisable artist styles are copied.
assets.format: SVG line art plus fill and shadow region masks (KTX2 R8 x3), balloon-zone rect, focal point; drawn at 2048 on the long side; three crops (wide, square, tall) declared as rects.
assets.dimensions: 2048 on the long side; crops for wide, square and tall panels.
assets.layer_structure: Line art, flat fills, shadow, highlight, balloon zone.
assets.animation: Limited: one element may carry a 2-4 frame loop (rain, steam, blink of a light, flicker).
assets.colour_behaviour: Fills mapped by the register's palette; tones by the register's tone set.
assets.asset_compatibility: All registers; balloon zone must fit a balloon of 8 words at panel size.
assets.exclusion_rules: No recurring characters; figures only as anonymous silhouettes, hands, backs or crowds; no identifiable people, brands or real landmarks.
assets.performance: Under 3 MB per illustration including masks.
assets.acceptance_criteria: Reads at panel size on a phone; balloon zone clear; works in all registers (checked in the register review); not a copy of any existing comic panel.

assets.purpose: Symbolic objects for pop pages and memory.
assets.references: Phase 1 C.12; research B.22 (Ben-Day dots and screentone); public-domain comics for lettering and panel grammar only. No existing characters, mascots, logos or recognisable artist styles are copied.
assets.format: SVG line art plus fill and shadow region masks (KTX2 R8 x3), balloon-zone rect, focal point; drawn at 2048 on the long side; three crops (wide, square, tall) declared as rects.
assets.dimensions: 2048 on the long side; crops for wide, square and tall panels.
assets.layer_structure: Line art, flat fills, shadow, highlight, balloon zone.
assets.animation: Limited: one element may carry a 2-4 frame loop (rain, steam, blink of a light, flicker).
assets.colour_behaviour: Fills mapped by the register's palette; tones by the register's tone set.
assets.asset_compatibility: All registers; balloon zone must fit a balloon of 8 words at panel size.
assets.exclusion_rules: No recurring characters; figures only as anonymous silhouettes, hands, backs or crowds; no identifiable people, brands or real landmarks.
assets.performance: Under 3 MB per illustration including masks.
assets.acceptance_criteria: Reads at panel size on a phone; balloon zone clear; works in all registers (checked in the register review); not a copy of any existing comic panel.
